gaps.evidence: Extractor compares float(point evidence coordinates) to finite canonical coordinates without first requiring finiteness; abs(NaN - value) > tolerance is false.
gaps.required: Reject non-finite evidence coordinates before comparison and serialize strict JSON.

gaps.evidence: Point and HMLR evidence rows are read without binding slot_id, expected status, final_ready=false and fake_data=false.
gaps.required: Require exact top-level identity, readiness and safety flags before row access.

gaps.evidence: Current task pins point and HMLR evidence blobs, but the extractor does not compare either input file to those expected blob SHAs.
gaps.required: Pass and verify exact expected Git blob/SHA256 values for both evidence inputs.

gaps.evidence: Seed area is only converted through a finite-number helper; zero, negative or implausibly large areas are not rejected.
gaps.required: Require positive bounded area and compare fresh polygon area to the preserved seed under a documented tolerance.

gaps.evidence: HMLR preparation converts seed longitude/latitude directly to floats and the post-transform range check does not explicitly reject NaN/Infinity.
gaps.required: Require finite geographic coordinates and finite projected coordinates before bounds tests.

gaps.evidence: The requested HMLR URL must be HTTPS and the final host is allowlisted, but the final redirect scheme is not revalidated.
gaps.required: Require every redirect and the final URL to remain HTTPS on approved hosts.

gaps.evidence: Preparation loads an existing hmlr_exact_matches.json after a zero matcher exit without deleting it first or requiring a current run token.
gaps.required: Use a clean generation path and bind matcher output to the launched invocation and starter SHA.

gaps.evidence: Matcher output omits starter-manifest SHA/generation and candidate top-level identity; downstream cannot prove which input produced the matches.
gaps.required: Persist exact starter SHA, task/attempt/continuation and generation in the matcher receipt.

gaps.evidence: Matcher requires only three candidate objects; it does not independently require exact target rows or distinct parcel and HMLR identities.
gaps.required: Require rows 30762/46142/61522 and three distinct parcel/HMLR identities.

gaps.evidence: Matcher limits file count but not total feature count, vertex count, geometry size or output size; WKT and GeoJSON duplicate full geometries.
gaps.required: Apply bounded feature/vertex/output budgets and avoid duplicate unbounded geometry serialization.

gaps.evidence: Matcher writes directly to the final path and default json.dumps permits NaN tokens.
gaps.required: Write strict allow_nan=false JSON to an attempt-scoped temporary file, validate and atomically replace.

gaps.evidence: Capabilities and DescribeCoverage use stream=False and response.content is fully buffered before the MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES check.
gaps.required: Stream with a hard cumulative byte limit before buffering or parsing.

gaps.evidence: Sampler reads data[0] without requiring exactly one numeric elevation band or validating dtype/range metadata.
gaps.required: Require one expected numeric elevation band and bind its range field/unit.

gaps.evidence: Sampler records resolution but does not require zero rotation/shear, north-up orientation, finite transform or positive exact pixel dimensions.
gaps.required: Validate the complete affine transform and expected one-metre north-up grid semantics.

gaps.evidence: EA sampler writes directly to its final JSON path with default allow_nan behavior.
gaps.required: Use strict JSON, fsync, validation and atomic replacement under a run generation.

gaps.evidence: Web candidate binding verifies row, HMLR ID, metric and confidence but never verifies parcel_id.
gaps.required: Bind exact row-to-parcel-to-HMLR identity for all three candidates.

gaps.evidence: Served operation rows are checked for number continuity and fake_data=true only; slot/task/attempt/continuation/final_ready are not enforced.
gaps.required: Require exact identity and safe flags on every operation row or a hash-bound parent document.

gaps.evidence: Any contiguous unique operation-number range of the declared length passes; the expected first and last operation numbers are not pinned.
gaps.required: Bind the exact operation range or a generation-specific range digest.

gaps.evidence: Web verifier writes the final acceptance receipt directly with json.dump.
gaps.required: Publish a strict, generation-bound receipt through atomic validated replacement.
